posts.title_en: [Info] 470x club + FAQ
posts.summary_en: Group #1 player 캔디애플 (guild 탄산수맛쿠키) posts three Pinata raid decks at ~1.03-1.05G team power scoring 455G, 470.5G and 561.9G (≈442x/448x/540x) with a Seeker at only 5★, plus an FAQ on sugar runes, perks (20%/7% = 열정페이+초고속승진), ATK order and why filler cookies are Lv.1. The later, stronger deck is a Melon Soda + Jungle Warrior deck with move speed (이속) sugar-rune lines only on Pinot Noir to control arrival order/positioning. The 129-comment thread covers move-speed micro-tuning, Milk dying at ~24s (fix: use Herb), and Scorpion stealing Pomegranate's buff.

posts.title_en: [Info] Guild Conquest Cherry deck 460x setup (AI-made image warning)
posts.summary_en: Full infographic guide for the stability-oriented Cherry deck: 451.05G at 973.96M (≈463x; later 483x with same setup) with a 10★ Seeker. Covers roster/levels, leader Milk + perks 열정페이+초고속승진, ATK ranking 1–6, pets (Wasabi Octopus, Hot Dog, Panda) with their effects, gear substats per slot in three progression stages, per-cookie sugar runes, and a Q&A. Expected spread: floor 150x, average 250–350x, peak 400x+.

scores.deck: 체리덱 (Cherry + Jungle Warrior + Scorpion Lv.1, Seeker 10★)
commenter; wipes at 30 s even with Herb

teams.name: 체리덱 (Cherry deck)

cookies.note: dark; for lift resistance with Panda
fire; placement only despite being a sub-DPS
light; 실론나이트 쿠키; ATK rank 6 (level tuned)

pets: 와사비문어 20★ (아군 지속 시너지 +40%, 지속 시너지를 받는 아군 공격력 10% 증가)
teams.perks: Leader 우유; 복지 열정페이 (highest-ATK ally +20% ATK, −20% max HP) + 초고속승진 (highest-ATK ally +7% ATK). Mercenary 베테랑 용병단 Lv4 (adds 2nd perk slot, 3rd pet slot, leader ATK/DEF/HP +10%).
teams.formation: No move speed on any gear or rune; Cherry and Scorpion exist only to give the optimal placement for buffs to be exchanged cleanly.
substitutions: If the team wipes around 30 s: 허브 instead of 정글전사, and drop 실론나이트 to Lv.1 (lower ceiling, more stability)
If you can tune move speed: 메론소다 instead of 체리 (higher ceiling, huge sugar-rune cost)
unorthodox: Scorpion (a sub-DPS) at Lv.1 — used only for placement, for stability
Ceylon at Lv91 deliberately to separate ATK rank 6
Pinot Noir at Lv.1 purely as a lift-resistance carrier
Wasabi Octopus + Hot Dog instead of 갓방울

sugar_runes.why: Milk's ATK is directly converted into its buff, so push ATK via runes and perks; commenters: ATK% runes are basically Milk-only.
Corrected after comments: Dark Choco's DEF shred is not boosted by skill amp, so use haste to stack faster.

sugar_runes.stats: never 이동속도 unless you are micro-tuning speed

gear.slot: A (무기/왼쪽 위 — three weapons, top-left block)
gear.substats: stage 1: –; stage 2: 스증 + 치확 or 치피; final: 스증 + 치확 or 치피
stage 1: 스가 3 parts; stage 2: 스가 + 스증; final: 스가 + 스증
stage 1: 스가 3 parts; stage 2: 스가 3 parts; final: 스가 + 피감
never roll 이동속도; 0–3 lines only if you are tuning speed yourself

rng: '세계선 찾기' (finding the lucky world-line) — deck is tuned to minimise retries rather than maximise peak.
Straw-jumping (Pomegranate buff alternating between cookies) can be exploited for a higher-peak build, but randomness raises retries too much.
Levelling fillers above Lv.1: if Milk or Wasabi Octopus buff lands wrong, the ATK order for Pomegranate's buff gets tangled.
mechanics: ATK order exists only to receive Pomegranate's buff; Pomegranate itself may exceed the ranked cookies' ATK.

Pomegranate straws: buffed by Herb → 5 straws; buffed by Jungle Warrior → 6 straws. Hence with Herb only ranks 1–5 get buffed, and Ceylon (rank 6) is dropped to Lv.1 to widen the ATK gap and stop straws bouncing.
If you do level a filler, keep its ATK ≥10% below the rank-6 cookie.
Lift resistance is needed so the boss's airborne (에어본) doesn't interrupt skills → Pinot Noir + Panda.
Buff/debuff stacking and Bright Seeker's single-target damage are the core of the deck.
Guide assumes a high-spec account whose Lv.1 cookies survive the 30 s stomp (30초 스탬프 구간).
Dark Choco's DEF shred is not amplified by 스증 (commenters, accepted by author).
disagreements: Dark Choco runes: original image said 스증-type; commenters said DEF shred ignores skill amp → author changed to 스가.
캔디애플: Cherry deck breaks the moment any move speed is added; do speed tuning only with Melon Soda. Author agrees: Cherry deck should strip all speed from gear and runes.
Commenter: Pomegranate straws attach badly to Ceylon.
Seeker star level: Q1 concedes the result may be because Seeker is 10★; a commenter says high Seeker stars are mandatory.

quotes.kr: 체리덱의 지향점은 적당한 고점을 찾으면서도 세계선 찾기 트라이 횟수를 최소화 하는데 있다고 생각함
quotes.en: The Cherry deck aims for a decent peak while minimising the number of tries to find the lucky run.

quotes.kr: 서브딜러인 전갈은 왜 1렙줌? -> 안정성 지향이라 전갈/체리는 걍 배치용으로만 썻음
quotes.en: Why is sub-DPS Scorpion Lv.1? → Stability-oriented, Scorpion/Cherry are used purely for placement.

quotes.kr: 메소넣고 이속 미세조절 가능하면 그게 고점 더 높음. 대신 이속세팅은 정답이 없고 사람마다 필요한 수치가 다름
quotes.en: Melon Soda with fine-tuned speed has a higher ceiling, but there's no single right speed; everyone needs different values.
Floor 150x, average 250–350x, peak 400x+.

quotes.kr: 위 여섯 쿠키 + 석류맛 쿠키 100레벨 ... 나머지 쿠키는 1레벨 주기.
quotes.en: The six ranked cookies + Pomegranate at Lv100; all other cookies Lv.1.

quotes.kr: 버프/디버프의 중첩과 브라이트시커 쿠키의 단일딜이 핵심이기 때문에 갓방울 대신 와사비문어 + 핫도그 장착.
quotes.en: Buff/debuff stacking and Bright Seeker's single-target damage are key, so Wasabi Octopus + Hot Dog instead of 갓방울.

quotes.kr: 띄우기 저항이 갖추어져 있어야 보스의 에어본에 스킬이 안 끊어지므로 피노아누맛 쿠키 + 판다 장착.
quotes.en: Lift resistance is needed so skills aren't interrupted by the boss's airborne, so Pinot Noir + Panda.

quotes.kr: 단순히 허브버프받은 석류 빨대는 5개 정전버프받은 석류 빨대는 6개 이 차이 때문에 허브로 바꾸면 5순위까지만 버프를 받음
quotes.en: Pomegranate buffed by Herb gets 5 straws, buffed by Jungle Warrior 6; so with Herb only ranks 1–5 get the buff.

quotes.kr: 닼초의 방깎은 스증버프 못받아서 스가를 활용한 빠른스택쌓는것도 좋습니다
quotes.en: Dark Choco's DEF shred doesn't benefit from skill amp, so use haste to stack faster.

quotes.kr: 우유의 경우에는 공격력수치 = 버프에 그대로 반영되다보니까 슈가룬으로 억지로 끌어올리고 복지까지 몰아 주는게 가장 효율이 좋음
quotes.en: For Milk, ATK translates directly into the buff, so forcing ATK up with runes and perks is most efficient.

quotes.kr: 정글전사 대신 허브맛 쿠키를 넣고 실론나이트 쿠키를 1레벨로 변경. 고점은 낮아지지만 안정성은 오름.
quotes.en: Replace Jungle Warrior with Herb and set Ceylon Knight to Lv.1 — lower peak but more stable.

quotes.kr: 이동속도 옵션은 절대 뽑지 말기. 본인이 이동속도 미세조절중이면 본인 판단하에 0~3줄 뽑기
quotes.en: Never roll move speed on gear; only 0–3 lines if you're micro-tuning speed yourself.

posts.title_en: Almost 600x
posts.summary_en: 캔디애플 (69368 author) hits 637.79G at 1.14G power (~559x) with a 5★ Seeker via the Melon Soda + Jungle Warrior deck and extreme move-speed micro-tuning. The sugar-rune screenshots show the speed values: Pinot Noir 0.26+0.57 (+0.32), Melon Soda 0.51+0.20, Seeker 0.32, Jungle Warrior three skill-haste lines. Scorpion's ATK was raised a bit (Lv7) so Pomegranate's buff stops bouncing to Melon Soda.

scores.note: timer 17.233; guild 탄산수맛쿠키 5T 353G 1st; personal group rank 2 (허허 665.42G).

teams.name: 메소정전 (Melon Soda + Jungle Warrior)

cookies.note: ATK raised slightly to stop Pomegranate jumping to Melon Soda

teams.perks: not stated (same account as 69368: 열정페이 + 초고속승진)
teams.formation: Move speed from sugar runes only (no gear speed) on Pinot, Melon Soda and Seeker; aligns team in one line (일렬/일자 정렬).
unorthodox: Scorpion Lv7, Pinot Lv2, Melon Soda Lv2, Dark Choco Lv6 — levels used as fine ATK-ordering knobs
Seeker given a move-speed rune line despite having only 3 unlocked rune slots at 5★

C 방어력 증폭 1.40%, R 이동속도 +0.51 (locked), C 체력 증폭 1.40%, U 방어력 증폭 2.30%, C 이동속도 +0.20 (locked), U 피해감소 2.60%

rng: Speed values 0.2/0.26/0.29 on Seeker all failed; 0.32 aligned. If speed tuning fails 'you want to quit the game'.
True peak = on the 2nd Pomegranate cast Jungle Warrior's buff lands, Ceylon's skill fires, Milk's ATK buff drops off and Scorpion receives Pomegranate.
mechanics: Sugar rune slot count is gated by star level: 5★ Seeker has 3 usable slots; extra slots unlock at ★6, ★8 (×2) and ★10 (×2).
Author estimate: a 10★ Seeker on this setup would give ~1000x.
disagreements: Author warns he takes no responsibility if copying his speed values lowers your score (individual variance).

quotes.kr: 개선한점: 전갈 공을 좀 높여서 가끔 메소한테 석류 튀는거 개선

posts.summary_en: Bright Seeker sugar rune screen: SR 스가 +3.00, SSR 스가 +4.00, SR 스가 +2.00 (unlocked), and pre-locked star-gated slots (★8 SSR 스가 +4 ×2, ★10 SSR 스가 +4 and +5; ★6 U 공증 2.30% unlocked). Commenters mock locking the ★8/★10 slots when the user won't reach those stars, since locks raise the reroll cost (240 crystals per roll).

sugar_runes.stats: SR 스가+3.00, SSR 스가+4.00, SR 스가+2.00; star-gated: ★6 공증 2.30%, ★8 SSR 스가+4.00 ×2 (locked), ★10 SSR 스가+4.00 and +5.00 (locked)

mechanics: Star-gated rune slots can be rolled and locked before the cookie reaches that star; locking raises reroll cost (240 per reroll shown with 5 locks).
disagreements: Commenters: pointless to lock ★8/★10 slots if you won't reach those stars — wastes rune crystals.
